desc: Derive the geometric visibility condition: building i is blocked from (0,h) iff h <= intercept of line through some (X_j,H_j) and (X_i,H_i) with j < i.
Reduce the problem to computing M = max_{j<i} (X_i*H_j - X_j*H_i)/(X_i-X_j); answer is M if M >= 0, else -1.
Implement the incremental upper convex hull with tangent binary search using exact integer cross-multiplication for comparisons.
Fix the output formatting: print f"{best_num / best_den:.18f}" (float division, 18 decimals); all 4 samples PASS.
